answer: The umber counter is kept in pearl and karst publishes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 2 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
